description: 976 Couverture 4G - Réseau Orange is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ARCEP. 4G coverage card of Orange mobile phone network on the department of Mayotte. Coverage: ARCEP. The portal shows the English title as "976 4G Coverage — Orange Network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ARCEP. Its keywords include Couverture réseau, Orange mobile, Mayotte, 976, Réseau mobile, Téléphonie. The listing shows 2019-02-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
